hypothesis.name: rarity_penalty_vs_channel_SSA
hypothesis.statement: At theta* the V2 circuit shows a uniform rarity/context penalty (deviant-below-standard) carried across channels by pulse-cycle entrainment, not channel-specific SSA. Channel-specific SSA would require deviant > standard within each channel when role controls are applied.
hypothesis.H1_SSA: Channel-specific SSA: Delta_R_A >0 and Delta_R_B >0 with BCa lower>0, si_a+si_b>0, and pooled swap |mean|<=0.10 CI including 0, SI_many<0.10.
hypothesis.H2_rarity_penalty: Uniform rarity penalty: Delta_R_A <0 and/or Delta_R_B <0 (BCa upper<0), si_a+si_b<=0, many-standards clean, phase-matched control predicts penalty vanishes when deviant phase aligned.
hypothesis.H3_fixed_preference: Fixed spatial preference (pre-adversarial): would produce swap asymmetry but no per-channel inversion; already falsified by per-channel flip sign analysis (11/20 A>B) and per-channel negative contrasts.
hypothesis.null_like: No systematic per-channel effect: Delta_R CIs include 0
hypothesis.scope: Tested at frozen theta* only (drive_E 4.0 drive_I 2.0 weight_mu 0.25); no claim about other operating points; bounded interpretation per E2_SYNTHESIS.
hypothesis.best_supported_after_review: Sign-inverted cross-channel carryover / rarity-penalty (H2), not fixed preference; per 11_E2_NEGATIVE_MECHANISTIC_INTERPRETATION.md REVISED attribution

per_channel_role_controlled_contrasts.definition: Role-controlled contrasts isolate channel history from identity gain. For channel A: Delta_R_A = R(A_as_deviant in oddball_B_std_flip) - R(A_as_standard in oddball_A_std). For channel B: Delta_R_B = R(B_as_deviant in oddball_A_std) - R(B_as_standard in oddball_B_std_flip). R is population_R mean spikes per 0.08s Hz in W_primary [30,110) ms across 800 E neurons, event-averaged post-washout per replicate, then pooled across n_outer=20 replicates.
per_channel_role_controlled_contrasts.Delta_R_A_formal: Delta_R_A[r] = R_A_dev[r] - R_A_std[r] per replicate r; R_A_dev = mean_R over A-deviant events (events where stimulus==A and block==oddball_B_std_flip, post-washout, deviant positions per hashed sequence); R_A_std = mean_R over A-standard events (block==oddball_A_std, post-washout, standard events). Pooled Delta_R_A = mean_r Delta_R_A[r].
per_channel_role_controlled_contrasts.Delta_R_B_formal: Delta_R_B[r] = R_B_dev[r] - R_B_std[r]; R_B_dev from oddball_A_std deviant events, R_B_std from oddball_B_std_flip standard events; pooled Delta_R_B = mean_r Delta_R_B[r].
per_channel_role_controlled_contrasts.SI_per_channel_form: si_A[r] = (R_A_dev[r] - R_A_std[r])/(R_A_dev[r] + R_A_std[r] + epsilon) with epsilon=1e-09 frozen; si_B similarly; pooled si_A = mean_r si_A[r]; pooled si_B = mean_r si_B[r]. Direction: si>0 means deviant>standard (SSA-like); si<0 means rarity penalty.
per_channel_role_controlled_contrasts.historical_reference: V2 receipts post-hoc per-channel: channel A -1.30 Hz [BCa -1.77,-0.79]; channel B -1.08 Hz [-1.68,-0.50] (BCa over 20 reps, same W_primary) — same stimulus deviant BELOW standard in both channels, per 11:45

per_channel_role_controlled_contrasts.pass_criteria_for_SSA: Channel-specific SSA requires Delta_R_A >0 with BCa 95% CI lower>0 AND Delta_R_B >0 with BCa lower>0 (and si_A>0 si_B>0 with lower>theta_SI/2). Both channels must independently show deviant>standard.
per_channel_role_controlled_contrasts.falsifier_per_channel: FALSIFIED_channel_SSA_contradicted if BCa 95% CI upper<0 for Delta_R_A OR for Delta_R_B (or for si_A/si_B): i.e., upper bound below zero => deviant significantly below standard within that channel => channel-specific SSA actively CONTRADICTED, not merely unsupported (per 11:45). Single-channel contradiction defeats universal channel-specific SSA claim; joint V2 receipts show both channels contradicted.
verbatim_per_channel_falsifiers: FALSIFIER_Delta_R_A: channel-specific SSA contradicted if BCa 95% CI for Delta_R_A has upper < 0 Hz (deviant below standard when stimulus identity held fixed, role varies) — per 11:45
FALSIFIER_Delta_R_B: channel-specific SSA contradicted if BCa 95% CI for Delta_R_B has upper < 0 Hz — per 11:45
FALSIFIER_si_A: channel-specific SSA contradicted if BCa 95% CI for si_A has upper < 0
FALSIFIER_si_B: channel-specific SSA contradicted if BCa 95% CI for si_B has upper < 0

swap_pooled.definition: Pooled role-reversal asymmetry statistic: per replicate SI_swap[r] = SI_A_std_block[r] - SI_B_std_block[r] where SI_A_std_block = (R_B_dev - R_A_std)/(R_B_dev+R_A_std+eps) computed on oddball_A_std block, SI_B_std_block = (R_A_dev - R_B_std)/(R_A_dev+R_B_std+eps) on oddball_B_std_flip block (signed swap asymmetry). Pooled swap_pooled = mean_r SI_swap[r] (signed mean across 20 replicates). Absolute gate applied to pooled value.

uncertainty.citation: K_analysis domain [3000,3999] per e2_ssa_spec.v6 seeds; B=5000 same as SI BCa

swap_pooled.pass_criteria: PASS requires |swap_pooled| <= 0.10 AND BCa 95% CI includes 0 (i.e., lower <=0 <= upper). CI including 0 indicates no systematic channel gain bias; |mean|<=0.10 ensures bias small. Both conditions required.
swap_pooled.falsifier: FALSIFIER_swap_pooled_BCa: pooled swap asymmetry falsifies specificity if |swap_pooled| > 0.10 OR BCa 95% CI excludes 0 (entirely above or below zero) — indicates fixed/preferential gain or asymmetric history transfer not consistent with stimulus-specific adaptation.
swap_pooled.verbatim_falsifier: FALSIFIER_swap_pooled_BCa: swap_pooled = mean_r SI_swap[r] with BCa B=5000 key K_analysis; FALSIFIED if |swap_pooled| > 0.10 OR BCa 95% CI excludes 0; max_over_reps FORBIDDEN per 12:R7

forbidden.max_over_reps: FORBIDDEN per 12:R7: swap_max = max_r |SI_swap[r]| or max_r swap_asym[r] is an extreme-value statistic (V2 sample max 0.426, median 0.105, only 10/20 exceed 0.10) and MUST NOT be used as gate. Do not report max_over_reps as pooled signature; do not gate on max. Pooled mean+CI is the only licensed swap gate.
forbidden.un_pooled_SI: FORBIDDEN: un-pooled single-block SI (e.g., SI computed collapsed across blocks without per-channel role separation) must not be substituted for per-channel or pooled swap contrasts
forbidden.note: max_over_reps appears in V2 receipts as swap_max_observed=0.426 diagnostic only; it is retained for archaeological record but is not a gate

many_standards.definition: SI_many[r] = (R_A_many[r] - R_B_many[r])/(R_A_many[r] + R_B_many[r] + epsilon) absolute or signed per SI_many_definition; R_A_many = mean_R on many_standards_control block events where stimulus==A, R_B_many similarly; post-washout events 78 realized (80-2). Methods: same W_primary [30,110) ms, same population_R.
many_standards.SI_many_definition_inherited: |(R_A - R_B)/(R_A + R_B + eps)| computed on many_standards_control block events
many_standards.pooled: SI_many_pool = mean_r SI_many[r] (or mean absolute); with BCa B=5000 key tag bca_SI_many
many_standards.pass: |SI_many_pool| < 0.10 (many-standards clean: no stimulus-energy bias at equal probability p_each=0.5) with BCa CI including 0 preferred
many_standards.falsifier: If |SI_many_pool| >= 0.10 with CI excluding 0, indicates stimulus-energy or fixed channel bias contaminant; S2 gate fails regardless of per-channel Delta_R
many_standards.V2_reference: V2 pooled SI_many 0.028 clean, shuffled -0.009 clean — retained as control gate

phase_matched_rarity_control_declaration.status: declared_prospective_control (not yet executed; required for any future rarity-penalty claim)
phase_matched_rarity_control_declaration.definition: When a carrier pulse regime is present (E2 theta* ~7.2 Hz, T~138 ms), rarity controls must be phase-matched to the carrier cycle. Deviant events must be compared at matched phase of the underlying population pulse: deviant timing aligned vs misaligned to pulse peak within +/- 5 ms window. This isolates true rarity/history effects from entrainment/phase-dependent excitability.
phase_matched_rarity_control_declaration.rationale: Per 12:R7: rarity controls must be phase-matched to the carrier cycle when a pulse regime is present; otherwise apparent penalty may be phase entrainment artifact (population pulse suppresses off-phase inputs). V2 200 ms ISI is not phase-locked to 138 ms carrier, producing mixed phases.
phase_matched_rarity_control_declaration.prospective_implementation: Future e2_d execution must include (or declare as second battery) a phase-matched rarity block: isochronous train at theta* period (T~138 ms) or triggered deviants at fixed phases (peak vs trough), with condition pulse-phase as covariate; analysis: stratify deviant responses by carrier phase quartile and test penalty vanishing when deviant phase aligns to pulse cycle => entrainment mechanism. If penalty vanishes on alignment, rarity-penalty = entrainment; if persists across phases, true cross-channel suppression.
phase_matched_rarity_control_declaration.acceptance: Declaration present in prereg suffices for D1; execution of phase-matched control is required before any positive rarity-penalty mechanism is claimed beyond discrimination.
phase_matched_rarity_control_declaration.citation: 12_BIOPHYSICAL_SIMULATION_RULES.md R7 rarity-controls phase-matched clause; 11_E2_NEGATIVE_MECHANISTIC_INTERPRETATION.md:50 phase-matched rarity control falsifier

falsifiers.per_channel_falsifiers_note: Either channel upper<0 suffices to contradict universal channel-specific SSA; both channels upper<0 (as in V2 post-hoc -1.30 [-1.77,-0.79] and -1.08 [-1.68,-0.50]) is stronger contradiction proving uniform penalty.
falsifiers.swap_pooled_BCa_falsifier: FALSIFIER_swap_pooled_BCa: swap_pooled = mean_r SI_swap[r] with BCa B=5000 key K_analysis; FALSIFIED if |swap_pooled| > 0.10 OR BCa 95% CI excludes 0; PASS requires |swap_pooled| <=0.10 CI including 0; max_over_reps FORBIDDEN per 12:R7 and must not be used (extreme-value 0.426 in V2 is max_over_reps statistic, not pooled signature).

ulanovsky_diagonal.definition: Ulanovsky-2003 diagnostic: genuine SSA requires each frequency channel SI above diagonal: SI(f1)+SI(f2)>0. Adapted to channels: si_a = per-channel SI for A (A_dev vs A_std), si_b = per-channel SI for B (B_dev vs B_std); pooled sum S = si_a_pool + si_b_pool (where si_a_pool=mean_r si_A[r], si_b_pool=mean_r si_B[r]). Also per-replicate S[r]=si_A[r]+si_B[r] may be pooled.
ulanovsky_diagonal.check: Compute S = si_a_pool + si_b_pool with BCa B=5000 key tag bca_ulanovsky_S (or BCa on sum). Genuine SSA predicts S > 0 with BCa lower > 0 (above diagonal).
ulanovsky_diagonal.falsifier: FALSIFIER_ulanovsky_diagonal: SSA falsified if si_a + si_b <= 0 (below diagonal) with BCa 95% CI upper <=0 or point estimate negative below diagonal; V2 observed S ~ -0.169 lies BELOW diagonal — defeating both canonical accounts simultaneously per 11:48 and strengthening frozen NEGATIVE.
ulanovsky_diagonal.verbatim: FALSIFIER_ulanovsky_diagonal: genuine SSA requires si_a + si_b > 0 with BCa lower >0; FALSIFIED if si_a+si_b <=0 (BCa upper<=0) — below gain-bias diagonal per Ulanovsky Las & Nelken 2003 Nat Neurosci
ulanovsky_diagonal.citation: Ulanovsky N, Las L, Nelken I (2003) Processing of low-probability sounds by cortical neurons. Nat Neurosci 6(4):391-398 doi:10.1038/nn1032; 11_E2_NEGATIVE_MECHANISTIC_INTERPRETATION.md:48; 09_SSA_DEVIANCE.md:14

falsifiers.SI_many_falsifier: FALSIFIER_SI_many: SSA stimulus-specificity falsified if |SI_many_pool| >= 0.10 with BCa CI excluding 0 (many-standards fails: stimulus identity bias not history).
falsifiers.joint_logic: Hypothesis discrimination: FALSIFIED_SSA (channel-specific SSA contradicted) if per-channel upper<0 OR ulanovsky S<=0; SUPPORTED_SSA only if per-channel lower>0 AND swap_pooled PASS AND SI_many PASS AND S>0; rarity-penalty SUPPORTED if per-channel upper<0 (penalty direction) AND SI_many clean AND phase-matched control shows penalty phase-dependent or history-dependent pattern. max_over_reps must never contribute to SUPPORTED/FALSIFIED verdict.
